The following limitations apply when you designate OpenSearch Service domains or OpenSearch
Serverless collections as sinks:
• A pipeline can't write to more than one VPC domain.
• You can only migrate data to or from OpenSearch Serverless collections that use VPC access.
Public collections aren't supported.
• You can't specify a combination of VPC and public domains in a single pipeline conﬁguration.
• You can have a maximum of 20 non-pipeline sinks within a single pipeline conﬁguration.
• You can specify sinks from a maximum of three diﬀerent AWS Regions in a single pipeline
conﬁguration.
• A pipeline with multiple sinks might experience a reduction in processing speed over time if
any of the sinks are down for too long, or are not provisioned with enough capacity to receive
incoming data.
